person.not_for_agents_hint: agents read the screen of another with mestre check; people use mestre attach
person.bad_detach_key_hint: use a control key, such as ctrl-] or ctrl-a
person.bad_redirect: the panel redirected to an address that makes no sense
person.busy_confirm: the agent is working. Type anyway? [y/N]
person.ca_invalid: the CA of the Guild in {{path}} is not valid
person.ca_invalid_hint: the file is not a PEM certificate; the engine writes it again when it starts
person.ca_unreadable: cannot read the CA of the Guild ({{path}}): {{detail}}
person.ca_unreadable_hint: the engine of this machine writes it when it runs; check that `mestre run` has run here and that you may read the folder of the instance (or use --dir)
person.cert_unverified: cannot verify the certificate of the panel: {{detail}}
person.cert_unverified_hint: the certificate of the panel is not from the CA of this Guild; check the address, or --server
person.character_not_visible: there is no character "{{name}}" that you see
person.character_not_visible_hint: check the name on the canvas, and the campaign
person.connection_lost_timeout: the connection to the panel was lost for {{duration}}
person.connection_lost_timeout_hint: run mestre debug on the machine of the Citadel; the agent was not touched
person.engine_stopped: the engine stopped with an error: {{detail}}
person.help: mestre attach shows, and with --write types into, the terminal of a character
person.hint_bug: this is a bug; run mestre debug
person.hint_bug_panel: this is a bug of the panel
person.hint_https: the panel is served over https
person.instance_in_no_guild: this instance is in no Guild: {{detail}}
person.list_failed: the panel cannot list the terminals ({{status}})
person.login_blocked: invalid user or password, or the login is blocked
person.login_blocked_hint: check the user and the password; after too many mistakes the login is blocked for a while
person.needs_a_character: mestre attach takes the name of one character
person.needs_a_terminal: mestre attach needs a terminal for the login and for the screen
person.needs_root: mestre setup-code needs root (Linux) or an administrator (Windows)
person.no_answer_hint: answer the question, or run without --write
person.not_citadel: this machine is not the Citadel: the code of setup is made where the Guild was created
person.not_for_agents: mestre attach is not a command of agents (MESTRE_AGENT_ID is in the environment)
person.not_serving: the panel answered {{status}} and is not serving now
person.not_serving_hint: the Citadel is suspended or being changed; try again in a moment
person.notice_output_lost: part of the output was lost (it left the buffer of the machine)
person.notice_permission_prompt: the agent waits on a permission prompt: keys are refused, decide it by the approval
person.notice_typing_level: typing refused: your level does not allow it (read-only now)
person.notice_typing_signal: typing refused: the machine of the terminal has no signal
person.panel_no_answer_hint: check that the Citadel is running and that the address is right; run mestre debug on the machine of the Citadel
person.panel_no_terminal: the panel did not open the terminal ({{code}})
person.raw_mode: cannot put the terminal in raw mode: {{detail}}
person.read_failed: the panel cannot read the terminal ({{status}})
person.redirect_plain: the panel redirected to a plain address
person.server_bad: --server "{{value}}" is not an address of the panel
person.session_ended: the session was ended by the Citadel
person.session_ended_hint: log in again with mestre attach; the session ends when the user is suspended, changes the password or loses the campaign
person.too_many_redirects: too many redirects looking for the Citadel
person.too_many_redirects_hint: the Guild is changing its Citadel; try again in a moment
person.too_many_terminals: too many terminals open for this user
person.too_many_terminals_hint: close a terminal you have open, in the panel or in another attach
person.type_denied_hint: typing needs Administrator or above in the campaign of the character
person.which_character: "{{name}}" exists in more than one place that you see
